vertebrae.extractors.callable
=============================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.extractors.callable

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Custom callable feature extractor.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.extractors.callable.CallableExtractor


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: CallableExtractor(name, transform_fn, fit_fn = None, modality = 'unknown', extractor_type = 'custom_callable', recipe_data = None, allow_sparse = True, streaming_safe = False)

   Wrap a custom Python callable as a feature extractor.

   :param name: User-facing extractor name.
   :param transform_fn: Callable that converts inputs into dense or sparse embeddings.
   :param fit_fn: Optional callable invoked during `fit`.
   :param modality: Input modality metadata.
   :param extractor_type: Extractor family metadata.
   :param recipe_data: Extra serializable data to include in `recipe()`.
   :param allow_sparse: Whether sparse transform outputs are allowed.
   :param streaming_safe: Whether independent batches can be transformed without
                          access to the full dataset.


   .. py:method:: fit(X, y = None)

      Fit the callable extractor when a fit function is supplied.

      :param X: Input samples.
      :param y: Optional labels.

      :returns: This extractor.



   .. py:method:: transform(X)

      Transform inputs with `transform_fn` and validate embeddings.

      :param X: Input samples.

      :returns: Dense or sparse numeric embedding matrix.



   .. py:method:: fit_transform(X, y = None)

      Fit the extractor and transform inputs.

      :param X: Input samples.
      :param y: Optional labels.

      :returns: Dense or sparse numeric embedding matrix.



   .. py:method:: recipe()

      Return a serializable callable extractor recipe.

      :returns: JSON-compatible recipe dictionary.
